subproblem.title: Total boundedness in flat distance of IM currents with bounded mass and boundary mass on a compact set (Simon Ch. 6, proof of 7.2 (1)–(3))
subproblem.statement: Assume (SL) the exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_slicing_lipschitz (a dependency of the parent node), taken as an antecedent: assuming (C1), for every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) represented by an IMRep RT = (M, θ, ξ), every IMRep RB = (M', θ', ξ') representing ∂T and every L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, there are P_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) such that (1) for every open W, t ↦ M_W(P_t) is a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ M_W(P_t) dt ≤ L·M_W(T); (2) for L¹-a.e. t: P_t is IM, P_t(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from f⁻¹(t), and P_t(ω) = ∫_{M∩{f<t}} θ⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{k+1} − ∫_{M'∩{f<t}} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dH^k for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)); X − Y is the contract subtraction (pointwise on test forms). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors (covectorEuclideanNorm); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U is the contract structure IMRep U d; R represents X when X(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHᵈ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U), where ⟨ω, ξ⟩(x) = ξ(x)(ω(x)); μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M is R.measure; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off a set K if X(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from K. X_j ⇀ Y (WeaklyConvergesOn) means X_j(ω) → Y(ω) for every ω. V ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContained V U) means that closure V is compact and contained in U. Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, K ⊆ U compact, Λ ∈ [0, ∞) and ε ∈ (0, ∞]. Then there is a finite set 𝒬 ⊆ 𝒟_n(U) such that every IM A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with ∂A IM, A vanishing off K, M(A) ≤ Λ and M(∂A) ≤ Λ admits Q ∈ 𝒬 and IM currents R ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(U), S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with A(ω) − Q(ω) = ∂R(ω) + S(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) and M(R) + M(S) < ε (masses in [0, ∞]).
subproblem.lean_statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (RT : IMRep U (n + 1)) (RB : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ Ps : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Ps t).massOn W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Ps t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * T.massOn W) ∧ ∀ᵐ t, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ps t) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (f ⁻¹' {t}) → Ps t ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Ps t ω = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ ε : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → Λ ≠ ∞ → 0 < ε → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ A : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity A.boundary → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) K → A ω = 0) → A.mass ≤ Λ → A.boundary.mass ≤ Λ → ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), A ω - Q ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) ∧ R.mass + S.mass < ε
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 2 of the parent-supplied proof (Simon Ch. 6, proof of Theorem 7.2, (1)–(3), chapter-06.txt lines 2056–2090), parts (a), (b), (d), (e); part (c) (the case n = P) is the sibling deformation_top. Tools: the siblings deformation (sibling dor_lmb_fc_deformation; for m + 1 < P, radius r(ρ) = 2√P·ρ) and deformation_top (sibling dor_lmb_fc_deformation_top; for m + 1 = P, radius r(ρ) = 2√(P+1)·ρ) both state, under (SL): there is c ≥ 0 such that for every ρ > 0, compact K' ⊆ ℝ^P and IM T ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with ∂T IM and T vanishing off K', there are a finite set s of pairs p = (z_p, ι_p) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin n → Fin P) with ι_p strictly increasing, integers β_p and Π ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), IM R ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P), IM S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with Π(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} β_p ∫_{F_p} ω(x)(e_{ι_p(0)}, …, e_{ι_p(m)}) dHⁿ(x) for all ω (F_p := {x : ρz_{p,i} ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_{p,i} + 1) for i ∈ range ι_p, x_i = ρz_{p,i} otherwise}), T − Π = ∂R + S, (Σ_{p∈s}|β_p|)·ρⁿ ≤ c·M(T), M(R) ≤ cρ·M(T), M(S) ≤ cρ·M(∂T), F_p ⊆ cthickening(r(ρ), K') for p ∈ s, and R, S vanish off cthickening(r(ρ), K'). Also (C1) the reused accepted sibling dor_imrep_massOn_eq_measure_and_support: for open U, X ∈ 𝒟_d(U) and an IMRep R in U representing X, M_W(X) = μ_R(W) for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P, and spt X = U ∩ spt μ_R. (IMC) the reused accepted sibling cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub: (a) if U is open, M ⊆ M' ⊆ U are Borel and Hᵈ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, then for Hᵈ-a.e. x ∈ M and every linear subspace Q, M has approximate tangent space Q at x iff M' has (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt d · x Q); (b) if U is open, R = (M, θ, ξ) is an IMRep in U and E is Borel, there are A ∈ 𝒟_d(U) and an IMRep R' in U with carrier M ∩ E, multiplicity θ and orientation ξ that represents A (so μ_{R'} = μ_R⌞E); (c) if U is open and A, B ∈ 𝒟_d(U) are IM, then A − B is IM; (d) for every IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in any U and Hᵈ-a.e. x ∈ M, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every d-covector α. The zero current of any degree d in any U is IM: the IMRep with carrier ∅, multiplicity 0 and orientation 0 represents it (∅ is Borel and countably d-rectifiable by Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.countablyRectifiable_of_measure_zero, and every integral or a.e. condition over ∅ holds trivially).
0. The case n > P. An alternating n-linear map on the P-dimensional space ℝ^P vanishes when n > P (any n vectors are linearly dependent, AlternatingMap.map_linearDependent), so every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) is the zero form and every A ∈ 𝒟_n(U) is the zero current. Take 𝒬 := {0}; for any A use Q := 0, R := 0, S := 0 (IM by the remark above): A(ω) − Q(ω) = 0 = ∂R(ω) + S(ω) and M(R) + M(S) = 0 < ε. From now on n ≤ P, and DEF denotes deformation if n < P and deformation_top if n = P, with its constant c and radius r(ρ).
1. Choice of ρ. Choose ρ > 0 with 2·c·ρ·Λ < ε (in [0, ∞]; possible as Λ < ∞ and ε > 0: ρ := 1 if cΛ = 0, otherwise ρ := min(ε, 1)/(4cΛ) with ε read in (0, ∞]). Put K_r := cthickening(r(ρ), K), a compact set.
2. The finite set 𝒬. Let 𝒞 be the set of p = (z, ι) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin n → Fin P) with ι strictly increasing and F_p ⊆ K_r. 𝒞 is finite: (Fin n → Fin P) is finite, and ρz ∈ F_p ⊆ K_r with K_r bounded, so each |z_i| ≤ sup_{y∈K_r}|y|/ρ. Let B := ⌊cΛ/ρⁿ⌋ ∈ ℕ. Let 𝒬 be the set of X ∈ 𝒟_n(U) for which there are s ⊆ 𝒞 and integers b_p (p ∈ s) with |b_p| ≤ B and X(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} b_p ∫_{F_p} ω(x)(e_{ι_p(0)}, …, e_{ι_p(m)}) dHⁿ(x) for all ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). A current is determined by its values (GeometricCurrentOn.ext) and there are finitely many data (s, (b_p)_{p∈s}), so 𝒬 is finite (Set.Finite.of_finite_image along X ↦ (ω ↦ X ω)).
3. Extension by zero (parent step 2(a)). Let A be as in the statement, R_A = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep of A and R_∂ = (M', θ', ξ') an IMRep of ∂A.
 (a) U ∖ K is open and A vanishes on every form supported in it, so by (C1) μ_{R_A}(U ∖ K) = M_{U∖K}(A) = 0; as θ ≥ 1 on M ⊆ U this gives Hⁿ(M ∖ K) = 0. ∂A also vanishes off K (if tsupport ω ∩ K = ∅ then tsupport dω ∩ K = ∅ and ∂A(ω) = A(dω) = 0), so likewise H^m(M' ∖ K) = 0.
 (b) By (IMC)(b) with E := K (closed, hence Borel) the data (M ∩ K, θ, ξ) form an IMRep in U. The same data form an IMRep R̂ in univ: the carrier is ⊆ univ, and for compact K'' ⊆ ℝ^P, ∫_{M∩K∩K''} θ dHⁿ ≤ ∫_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ by the local integrability of R_A on the compact K ⊆ U; the other fields are unchanged. By (IMC)(b) in univ with E := univ there is Ǎ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) represented by an IMRep with carrier M ∩ K ∩ univ = M ∩ K and the same multiplicity and orientation, hence by R̂. Thus Ǎ is IM, Ǎ vanishes off K (its carrier lies in K), and for ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (also a test form on ℝ^P) Ǎ(ω) = ∫_{M∩K} θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ = A(ω) by (a). By (C1) (in univ and in U), M(Ǎ) = μ_{R̂}(ℝ^P) = μ_{R_A}(K) ≤ μ_{R_A}(U) = M(A) ≤ Λ.
 (c) The same construction for ∂A gives an IM Ž ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) represented by (M' ∩ K, θ', ξ'), vanishing off K, with Ž(ω) = ∂A(ω) for ω ∈ 𝒟^m(U) and M(Ž) ≤ M(∂A) ≤ Λ.
 (d) ∂Ǎ = Ž. Choose a smooth ζ with compact support in U and ζ = 1 on an open V ⊇ K (finitely many smooth bumps exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset covering K, combined by a partition of unity). For ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P), ζω ∈ 𝒟^m(U) and d(ζω) = dω on V (d is local and ζω = ω on V). As the carriers lie in K ⊆ V: ∂Ǎ(ω) = Ǎ(dω) = ∫_{M∩K} θ⟨dω, ξ⟩ = ∫_{M∩K} θ⟨d(ζω), ξ⟩ = Ǎ(d(ζω)) = A(d(ζω)) = ∂A(ζω) = Ž(ζω) = ∫_{M'∩K} θ'⟨ζω, ξ'⟩ = ∫_{M'∩K} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ = Ž(ω). So ∂Ǎ = Ž is IM and M(∂Ǎ) ≤ Λ.
4. Deformation (parent step 2(b)/(c)). Apply DEF (with the antecedent (SL)) to Ǎ, ρ and K' := K. It gives s, β, Π, R̂, Ŝ with: ι_p strictly increasing and F_p ⊆ K_r for p ∈ s, so s ⊆ 𝒞; Π(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} β_p ∫_{F_p} ω(x)(e_{ι_p(0)}, …, e_{ι_p(m)}) dHⁿ for all ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P); (Σ_{p∈s}|β_p|)ρⁿ ≤ cM(Ǎ) ≤ cΛ, so |β_p| ≤ B; R̂, Ŝ IM; Ǎ − Π = ∂R̂ + Ŝ; M(R̂) ≤ cρM(Ǎ) ≤ cρΛ and M(Ŝ) ≤ cρM(∂Ǎ) ≤ cρΛ.
5. Restriction to U (parent step 2(d)). Q := Π.restrictDomain (U ⊆ univ), R := R̂.restrictDomain, S := Ŝ.restrictDomain. By step 4, Q ∈ 𝒬 (data s and b_p := β_p). R and S are IM: if (N, ϑ, η) is an IMRep of R̂ in univ, (IMC)(b) in univ with E := U gives an IMRep with carrier N ∩ U; the same data form an IMRep in U (carrier ⊆ U, local integrability on compact subsets of U inherited) which represents R because every ω ∈ 𝒟^{n+1}(U) vanishes outside U, so ∫_N ϑ⟨ω, η⟩ = ∫_{N∩U} ϑ⟨ω, η⟩; the same for S. For ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U): A(ω) − Q(ω) = Ǎ(ω) − Π(ω) = R̂(dω) + Ŝ(ω) = ∂R(ω) + S(ω). Every form admissible for M(R) = M_U(R) is, regarded in ℝ^P, admissible for M(R̂) with the same value, so M(R) ≤ M(R̂) and likewise M(S) ≤ M(Ŝ). Hence M(R) + M(S) ≤ 2cρΛ < ε by step 1. ∎
proof_key_steps: If n > P every n-form on ℝ^P vanishes, so all currents are 0 and 𝒬 = {0} works.
Pick ρ with 2cρΛ < ε; the integer polyhedral chains on the finitely many grid cells inside cthickening(r(ρ), K) with coefficients ≤ cΛ/ρⁿ form a finite set 𝒬.
Extend A and ∂A by zero to IM currents Ǎ, Ž on ℝ^P (C1 shows the carriers lie a.e. in K; (IMC)(b) gives the currents) and check ∂Ǎ = Ž with a cutoff.
Apply the deformation theorem (n < P) or its top-dimensional case (n = P) to Ǎ: Ǎ − Π = ∂R̂ + Ŝ with Π a chain in 𝒬 and small M(R̂), M(Ŝ).
Restrict R̂, Ŝ, Π to U: restrictions stay IM, masses do not increase, and A − Q = ∂R + S with M(R) + M(S) ≤ 2cρΛ < ε.

audit.reason: The finite-net contract matches its prose. The proof covers n>P, n=P and n<P; verifies extension by zero and its boundary identity; bounds the finite cell and coefficient choices; and restricts the decomposition back to U without increasing mass. Its dependencies supply precisely the deformation results used.
